fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { newHires: "Build a direct deposit form for new hires at my company. Ask for the account holder's name, bank name, routing number, account number and account type, plus an upload of a voided check. Read the check and compare its routing and account numbers with what the employee typed. If anything differs, send the form back with that field marked. Only pass matching records to payroll.", splitDeposits: "Let my employees split each paycheck across up to three accounts. For each extra account they choose a fixed amount or a percentage, and exactly one account must take the remainder. Before they sign, show the split on a sample net pay of $2,140, for example $150 to savings and $1,990 to checking. Save each split as a row payroll can export.", bankChanges: "Build a page where employees change the bank account their pay goes to. Hold every change request and email a confirmation link to the personal address already in our HR record, not the one in the request. When the employee confirms, send our payroll manager Ana Kim a Slack direct message with the employee's name and the last four digits of the new account.", contractorPayouts: "Make a payout setup form for the contractors my company pays by ACH. Collect their bank details and a W-9 in the same submission. Compare the name on the bank account with the name on the W-9. If they match, add the contractor to the next payout run. If not, hold them for accounts payable to review and show the reason." };

acrm---key-feature-3-image.alt: A request to switch Priya Nair's deposit account is held until she confirms it from the address on file, then payroll manager Ana Kim gets a Slack direct message.

acrm---key-feature-4-image.alt: Contractors submit bank details with a W-9, and Jordan Reed's bank account name, Reed Design LLC, differs from the W-9 name, so accounts payable reviews it first.

afb---cover-image.alt: Direct deposit form: a direct message tells payroll manager Ana Kim that Priya Nair confirmed her new deposit account
